description: This donut chart, titled “Win rate (%)”, visually compares the performance of three large language models—GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral—in generating empathetic responses, as judged by Gemini. The chart is composed of three distinct colored segments: a small dark red slice labeled “GPT-4o: 12.0%”, a larger dark blue slice labeled “Mistral: 88.0%”, and a very large light blue slice labeled “LLaMA: 80.4%”. The chart includes a legend that connects each model’s name and its corresponding percentage to its colored segment. The central white circle contains the title “Win rate (%)”, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest segment (LLaMA) at the bottom right, followed by the medium-sized segment (Mistral) at the bottom left, and the smallest segment (GPT-4o) at the top. The chart does not show any exploded or emphasized slices, and the percentages are displayed as labels connected by lines to their respective segments.
